law: Quality picks the model. Cost only breaks a tie.
note: Read only observation of November 1, 2026. Running guest counts describe inventory, not application health. This static export makes no production network calls and establishes no future health window. Backup verification describes the latest snapshot reported for each guest only. It does not prove a restore, complete backup coverage or independent offsite recovery.
